proof_body:
by
  intro K _ n _ _ A b x h
  have hu : IsUnit A.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr h
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul A hu, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  · rintro rfl
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv A hu, Matrix.one_mulVec]
target_source: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] (n : Type*) [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix n n K) (b x : n → K), A.det ≠ 0 → (A.mulVec x = b ↔ x = A⁻¹.mulVec b)
